lines: #Every time you buy something you can't afford, it comes with a *chain.*
The new phone. The nicer car. The weekend on the *card.*
And suddenly your paycheck is spent before it even *arrives.*
#You go to work, not to build your *future.*
You can't say no to a bad job. You can't take a *risk.*
You can't build a future while you're still *paying* for the past.
#Freedom starts when the chains start coming *off.*
List everything you owe. Every single *one.*
Look at it. Even if it *hurts.*
Then start breaking the old ones, one at a *time.*
#Every chain you break gives you a little more *room.*
end: Follow for your daily push at 7am & 7pm.
